newsitem.title: USA: High Plains gets industrial ethanol pact.
newsitem.headline: High Plains gets industrial ethanol pact.

text.p: High Plains Corp said Wednesday it received a firm $17 million contract with an international trading company for the sale of at least 10 million gallons of industrial grade ethanol.
The contract is for the 12-month period beginning January 1997.
High Plains said this is its first sale of industrial grade ethanol.

High Plains said it recently purchased the majority of the equipment necessary to process its ethanol into a higher grade industrial product. The distillation and processing equipment was purchased from an another ethanol producer that had idled its plant because of high grain costs.

The equipment is being dismantled and shipped to the York, Neb., ethanol facility. High Plains said the $2.5 million plant modification should be completed by December 1996 and should allow High Plains to produce up to 15 million gallons of the higher quality ethanol.
